answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 48 POA per identity, released only after 10 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 380 fakes must lock 18240 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The mesa test is the live device, the cedar test is the locked stake, and the oasis test is the graded history no template can fake.
